name: Gaurav Rai
headline: AI, Data and Cloud Analyst and Engineer
summary: Analyst with more than six years across contact centres, IT support, reporting and cloud. At Bendigo Telco I rebuilt customer experience reporting in SQL and Power BI and worked on Amazon Connect, where I took WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Instagram messaging from pilot to production. Earlier I led a team of fifteen agents and lifted CSAT from 82% to 91% in six months. I use AI tools every day, including Claude Code and Codex. Based in Melbourne and available now.

skills.items: SQL, Power BI, Excel, MSPBots, Python, data validation, requirements gathering, CSAT, AHT and SLA reporting
contact flows, routing profiles, Contact Control Panel, WhatsApp and social messaging, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Terraform
Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Claude and OpenRouter APIs, MCP, prompt engineering
TypeScript, React, Node.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, Jira, HaloPSA

roles.title: Reporting Analyst, Customer Experience
bullets: Rebuilt customer experience reporting in SQL and Power BI, replacing hand built spreadsheets with weekly CSAT, AHT and SLA dashboards for managers.
Gathered reporting requirements across the business, checked data quality before every release and raised data risks through the risk framework.
Maintained dashboards in Power BI, Excel and MSPBots, and supported the Amazon Connect rollout by moving its configuration into Terraform.

roles.title: CX Enablement Intern
bullets: Connected WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Instagram to Amazon Connect from pilot to production, with Node.js Lambda functions and DynamoDB handling real time chat routing.
Built a React and TypeScript panel in the agent workspace that loads the HaloPSA customer record on call pop, cutting average handle time by 25%.
Rebuilt AWS monitoring after a root account compromise with CloudTrail, CloudWatch and Budgets alerts, and moved all Jira tickets into HaloPSA with no data lost.

roles.title: IT Support Analyst, contract
bullets: Supported 200+ business users across 24x7 rotating shifts and closed 95% of Level 1 and Level 2 tickets within SLA.
Built ticket reports in Python and SQL that exposed the top five recurring issues, and fixing them cut repeat incidents by 20%.

roles.title: Team Lead
bullets: Led fifteen agents across voice, email and chat, lifting CSAT from 82% to 91% in six months with QA scripts and KPIs.
Reworked scheduling and used Excel and SQL reports to find bottlenecks, cutting wait time by 20% and resolution time by 15%.

roles.title: Senior IT Support Analyst
bullets: Managed daily operations and sales targets for eight automotive dealerships with five analysts reporting to me.
Built a CRM escalation workflow that cut escalations by 25%, and trained 20+ new hires, lifting first contact resolution by 15%.

roles.title: IT Support Analyst
bullets: Handled 50+ customer enquiries a day at 95% retention and received the Extra Miler award and Employee of the Quarter.

projects.name: HoundShield
bullets: A prompt inspection firewall I built solo with Claude Code and Codex. It checks AI prompts for sensitive data on the customer's own hardware, runs 16 detection engines and is covered by 140 test suites.
